on 13 September, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:150560
Court No. - 80
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 13999 of 2016
Applicant :- Smt. Geeta @ Nisha And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pramit Kumar Pal,Ramesh Chandra Pal

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Habaldar Singh Katheria Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent, and perused the entire record.

2. The instant application has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned summoning order dated 3.10.2015 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chhibramau in Criminal Compliant Case No. 1266 of 2014, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC, P.S.
Chhibramau, District Kanauj, on the basis of the compromise.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have settled their dispute amicably vide compromise deed dated 07.12.2018.

He further submits that the applicants are Nanad and Nandoi of the opposite party no. 2, and the opposite party no. 2 as well as her husband- Pankaj Kumar Bajpayee came to an agreement that they will withdraw all the litigation pending against each other including family members.

He has drawn attention of the Court to the order dated Smt. Geeta @ Nisha And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96223857/
1 2.2.2024 passed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court wherein the charge sheet qua the father-in-law and mother-in-law has already been quashed on the basis of aforesaid compromise deed.

entities.text: Smt. Geeta @ Nisha And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next submits that since the disputes between the parties have been settled, the opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed further with the trial, and therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the matter pending.

4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has conceded the submissions of learned counsel for the applicants and submits that the opposite party no.2 has no objection, if the proceedings of the aforesaid case pending before the trial court are quashed.

5. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply a waste of judicial time as chances of conviction are very bleak.

6. In such circumstances, the impugned summoning order dated 3.10.2015 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chhibramau in Criminal Compliant Case No. 1266 of 2014,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC, P.S. Chhibramau, District Kanauj, against the applicants, are hereby quashed.
7. The instant petition stands allowed, accordingly.

8. In case the opposite party no. 2- complainant is aggrieved upon quashing of the aforesaid criminal proceedings, she is at liberty to approach before this Court for revival of the instant application as and when requires.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Ujjawal Justice Vinod Diwakar  Smt. Geeta @ Nisha And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96223857/
